# ITRO — Indian Testing & Research Organisation

> ITRO is an online exchange for discovering testing and research capabilities, laboratory services, equipment and technical experts offered by institutions in India.

Official website: https://itro.co.in/

## What the platform offers

- Discover testing services, tests and standards: https://itro.co.in/exchange
- Browse certification packages: https://itro.co.in/packages
- Find institutions and laboratories: https://itro.co.in/providers
- Explore laboratory instruments and equipment: https://itro.co.in/equipment
- Find researchers, technicians and consultants: https://itro.co.in/experts
- Browse workshops, webinars, training and open days: https://itro.co.in/events
- Browse industry capability pages: https://itro.co.in/industries/aerospace-defense
- Browse technology capability pages: https://itro.co.in/technologies/materials-characterization

## Information and accuracy

- Public catalog and institution information is supplied by the participating institutions and may change.
- Accreditation claims, scope and status should be verified with the issuing accreditation body.
- Pricing, availability and turnaround can depend on the selected provider and current quote.
- ITRO is a discovery and transaction platform; it does not itself certify test results.

- Sitemap: https://itro.co.in/sitemap.xml
